svg.title: primitiveUnits=objectBoundingBox
svg.desc: A non-square object bounding box (160x80) with a uniform red displacement map and scale=0.25. The scale is resolved per axis: scale_x=40 and scale_y=20, so the sampled content is shifted 20 units to the left and 10 units down, matching the dashed blue outline at (0, 30, 160, 80).
